notes.content: This year had a lot of roller coaster in store for me, I mean I went from having a girlfriend and being happy with her to breaking up within 2 months, had a internship but had to quit because it was taking a toll on me mentally and several frictions in the workplace, got several interviews and thought this is  the year I was going to breakout in tech but still none, I hope next year becomes better but all I know is that I won't stop grinding until I become filthy rich.

I want to talk about the past. I want to talk about when the whites infiltrated our countries. I want to talk about how the whites forced their believes on us. I want to talk about how the whites enslaved our people. I want to talk about how people where punished if they didn't obey. I want to talk about how there was hunger in our lands. I want to talk about how some of us fought and conquered. That's all I want to talk about.

resources.title: Year of Roller Coasters and Unwavering Grind
resources.summary: The year was marked by significant personal turbulence, including a rapid breakup and the withdrawal from an internship due to mental strain and workplace friction.
